## Decisions / Non-Findings

Findings demoted to Not Actionable by the False Alarm Filter. Future audits should NOT re-investigate them.

1. **compute_cost_usd has no arm matching any model in current use, so every run warns and is priced at placeholder Sonnet rates -- decisions.md D32 records this, leaves the figures unrepriced per T52 AC9 and assigns verified rate rows to EDMV4; CA-012 has now aligned the prose** (CA-105, L2+L4+L6) -- plugins/edm/bin/edm-state:365-427
2. **the wave-A eval baseline scores.json does not exist, so T23 AC8/AC9/AC13 all fail for one recorded reason -- D23 carries the seven attempts and an executable closing command, and edm-compare-eval's exit 3 (now reachable after the CA-007 fix) keeps an absent baseline from reading as a pass** (CA-106, L9+L11) -- plugins/edm/evals/baseline/README.md:3
3. **the tiered-versus-untiered cost section is gated on .tiering_results, which no producer writes -- the in-code comment states this and decisions.md D28 records the matrix as built, unit-verified and deliberately not run pending D23's baseline** (CA-107, L2) -- plugins/edm/bin/edm-state:2438-2457
4. **the T67 AC6 Mermaid-ratio budget is a bare ratio with no stated input size and no absolute ceiling -- decisions.md D26 calls the budget shape malformed and D29 carries the re-derivation as named ticket EDMV4-T01** (CA-108, L9) -- SRD/edm/EDMV3__prompt-streamline/decisions.md:34
5. **T67 AC9 and AC13 are recorded verified-locally-pending-pipeline rather than PASS because both need a live runner or a real costed eval run -- decisions.md D27 records the missing dependency in each case** (CA-109, L9) -- SRD/edm/EDMV3__prompt-streamline/decisions.md:35
6. **the banned-file-type scan uses git ls-files where T57 AC5 specified find -- decisions.md D30 accepts the deviation, amends the AC text, and records both forms measured returning 0 on the live tree** (CA-110, L9) -- SRD/edm/EDMV3__prompt-streamline/decisions.md:39
7. **the two pinned image digests and the bash:3.2 floating tag are self-declared placeholders that must be refreshed before the pipeline is first enabled, so no job can pull its image today -- documented and authorized in the file itself** (CA-111, L8) -- .gitlab-ci.yml:10-20
8. **test:smoke-bash32's floating image tag and the absent macOS runner are authorized named exceptions with recorded rationale and a refresh procedure in place; the apt-get divergence that shared this job is now fixed (CA-006) and the version assertion is present at :303** (CA-112, L7+L11) -- .gitlab-ci.yml:294
9. **em dashes in bin/tests/ comments are explicitly carved out of the ASCII sweep by vocabulary-allowlist.txt:25-28 because they are comments and never read as prompt text -- the one actionable residue is the line printed to stdout, filed as CA-079** (CA-113, L1+L8) -- plugins/edm/bin/tests/run-all.sh:2
10. **pattern_target_heading_for ignores its argument and always returns the same heading -- documented at :3585-3592 as the intentional extension point, contractually coupled to adding a README mapping row** (CA-114, L1+L2) -- plugins/edm/bin/edm-state:3619-3624
11. **the ignore set is deliberately not applied to grant source 2 because the lens launch template lives inside a fence and skipping it would blind the checker to the instruction it exists to catch** (CA-115, L7+L10) -- plugins/edm/bin/edm-check-grants:284
12. **edm-check-grants' actor-first output shape and its unconditional Edit warning are deliberate and required by T03 AC7 -- the shape is now the five-argument arm of the shared report_violation and the arity-keyed dual format names its own misuse; only the counter-name half of that function is raised, as CA-155** (CA-116, L2+L7+L10) -- plugins/edm/bin/_edm-lint-lib.sh:86-93
13. **has_tool runs set -- $list unquoted so each item is subject to pathname expansion, which is safe for every value on disk since no tool token matches a file and nullglob is off; now carries an explicit shellcheck disable with the bash-3.2 rationale** (CA-117, L1+L8) -- plugins/edm/bin/edm-check-grants:185
14. **git rev-parse --verify is not qualified to refs/heads/, so a branch name that also resolves as a commit-ish takes the exists path -- pre-existing and unreachable for the names this script generates** (CA-118, L1) -- plugins/edm/bin/edm-init:159
15. **cmd_migrate_schema's advance-by-one arithmetic is a no-op today, retained as defence against schema_version 3, which CLAUDE.md records as deliberately unassigned; the separate prose/code mismatch in its comment is CA-135** (CA-119, L2) -- plugins/edm/bin/edm-state:2013-2017
16. **cmd_compare is a second comparison implementation CI does not use, retained deliberately with the reason stated in place, reachable via the --compare dispatch arm and exercised by wave7-smoke.sh** (CA-120, L2) -- plugins/edm/evals/score-artifacts.sh:598-643
